description: SSRF through link-preview / URL-unfurl / oEmbed features. Load when the app generates a preview card for a user-supplied URL: chat/forum/comment link unfurling, "add a link" in posts or profiles, oEmbed endpoints, rich-text editors that auto-embed, bookmark/save-for-later tools, or any UI that shows an Open Graph title/image/description for a pasted link. Signals: params like url=, link=, embed=, preview=; a "fetching preview" spinner; response JSON with og:title / og:image fields; User-Agents like *bot, *crawler, Slackbot, Discordbot, or a fetch from a different egress IP than the app.
